notes.title: Update Silenced: The House
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings to all fans of our visual novel![/h2]

We are pleased to announce an update to our game that will bring numerous improvements, making your gaming experience even more exciting and immersive.

[h2]What's new in the update?[/h2]

[h3]Localization into 9 new languages[/h3]

We are excited to announce that our game is now available in nine new languages: Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Italian, and Ukrainian. This will allow even more players to enjoy our story.

[h3]Updated text and character backstories[/h3]

We have revised and expanded the game's textual elements, adding new dialogues to immerse you deeper into the storyline. Now, each character has a more detailed and rich backstory, allowing for a better understanding of their motives and actions.

[h3]Improved graphics quality[/h3]

We have enhanced the game's graphics to create an even more atmospheric and terrifying world lurking in the dark.

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

We have worked diligently to fix known bugs, especially those related to the save system and text scrolling issues.

[b]We thank you for your support and feedback, which helps us make the game better. Join the discussion in our community and share your impressions of the new update. Your opinion is very important to us!

If you have any additional questions or suggestions, please feel free to leave comments or contact us directly.

Enjoy the game and see you in the world of horror![/b]
